subtitle: Classic Klondike, no ads
promotionalText: Klondike as it should be: big, readable cards, tap or drag, and nothing in the way. No ads, no accounts, no tracking.
description: One Off Solitaire is classic Klondike for iPhone, iPad and Mac: big cards, quick play, and nothing else on the screen.
PLAY YOUR WAY
• Draw 1 or Draw 3, switched with one tap
• Tap a card to send it to its best spot, or drag it exactly where you want
• Undo your moves, and let Finish play out a game that's solved
• Hard Core: one pass through the deck in Draw 1, three in Draw 3
• Restart: play the same deal again from the start (turn it on in Settings)
SCORE EVERY GAME
• Points for every card you bring home and every suit you finish, plus a time bonus when you win
• Your Top 10 for each draw mode, synced across your devices with iCloud
• Game Center leaderboards for normal and Hard Core games
MAKE IT YOURS
• Four card faces (Classic, Big Index, Vintage and Night) and four card backs
• Win animations: Cascade, Rainfall, Decay, Shuffle, Random or None
• The draw pile on the left or the right
LEFT ALONE TO PLAY
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts, no tracking
• Your game is saved as you play and picks up where you left off
• Plays offline
• VoiceOver, Voice Control, larger text and Reduce Motion supported
Made by One Off Endeavors.
